caveats.en: Unofficial beta for Python 3.14, CUDA 13.4, and PyTorch 2.14. Needs a manual source edit and self-compiled dependencies. The upstream vLLM project has no official Windows Arm64 wheel.
caveats.zh-TW: 非官方 Beta 版，需要 Python 3.14、CUDA 13.4、PyTorch 2.14，還要手動修改原始碼並自行編譯相依套件。上游 vLLM 沒有官方 Windows Arm64 wheel。
